R/RETURNBYTHE RETURN DESK
LOCAL ONLY / NO INBOX CONNECTION

ORDER IN / DEADLINE OUT

Keep the window
on your side.

Paste a real confirmation. ReturnBy extracts order details, checks merchant policy and gives you a date to act on. Review every field, save multiple deadlines and export a real calendar reminder - no AI or account required.

01 / PASTE02 / REVIEW03 / REMEMBER
RETURN WINDOW30 DAYSDEFAULT WHEN A STORE IS UNKNOWN
RULE-BASED / EDITABLE / LOCAL

01 / START WITH THE ORDER

Paste a confirmation.

Only details you approve are saved. The original email stays in this text box until you clear it.

Load a fictional example
LOCAL

No inbox access. No upload. Parsing and calendar export run in this browser.

02 / YOUR ACTIVE TRACKER

Return windows.

Deadlines are recalculated each day and sorted by what needs attention first.

TRACKED0
DUE IN 7 DAYS0
OVERDUE0

    Saved items stay in this browser's local storage. Use the calendar button for an .ics reminder.

    Prepare a return-trip checklist →

    01

    Rules, not guesses.

    A parser extracts four fields. Missing values are highlighted so you can correct them before saving.

    02

    Policy with a fallback.

    Known stores use the local policy table. Unknown stores are clearly marked with an editable 30-day default.

    03

    Keep control.

    Each saved deadline can be exported as a calendar event with a three-day reminder or removed from the tracker.

    PRIVATE BY DESIGN. The pasted email is not stored or sent. Only reviewed order fields you save persist on this device.
